attempted_claim: Let X in P^4 over C be a factorial quartic threefold with exactly one ordinary double point, so X is Gorenstein terminal, Pic(X) congruent Z, (-K_X)^3=4. Determine the delta-invariant delta(X), in particular whether delta(X)>1 (resp. >=1), and hence whether X is K-stable (resp. K-semistable/K-polystable) in the sense of Fujita-Li / Fujita-Odaka / Blum-Jonsson. If delta(X)<=1, exhibit the prime divisor over X computing delta(X) and the induced K-polystable special degeneration. Route via Abban-Zhuang flags centred at and away from the node and G-equivariant valuative/beta criteria.
decisive_failure: Exact delta-invariant and K-stability remain undetermined: Abban-Zhuang flag constants could not be verified locally, the literature-search budget was exhausted, and the Zariski decomposition of pi*H-uE beyond tau=1 (lines through the node) was not completed. Only the nef-interval lower bound S_X(E)>7/8 is certified by output/artifacts/partial_S_node_certificate.py; no delta_p bound, computing divisor, or degeneration was established.
